Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Requires a type argument, or each <code>typeof</code> type passed to a [Type](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.type) parameter, to have a PostgreSQL
conversion. The compiler reports a closed type without one, such as [ulong](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uint64), as error ANKUS541.

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Parameter|AttributeTargets.GenericParameter, Inherited = false)]
public sealed class PgConvertibleAttribute : Attribute
```

SPI parameters and results, datum reads and writes, and function arguments use this contract. A type argument of
[PgRange&lt;T&gt;](/api/ankus.pgrange-1/) or the [PgRange](/api/ankus.pgrange/) factory must instead be a supported range bound, and ANKUS542
reports one that is not. Apply the attribute to a helper's own type parameter to check its callers the same way.
Open type parameters, [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object), interfaces and base classes of mapped types resolve their conversion
at run time.

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object), [Attribute](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.attribute)
